answer.reason: The private-sector BLS QCEW value for NAICS 23 Construction in Alabama for December 2024 is consistent with 107,667 covered jobs; the larger 126,532 figure likely reflects a broader measure that includes public-sector construction employment rather than QCEW private-sector jobs.

metadata.prompt:
Question: In the BLS QCEW fourth-quarter 2024 data for Alabama, what was the December 2024 private-sector employment level, in covered jobs, for NAICS 23 Construction?

A. 107,667 covered jobs
B. 126,532 covered jobs

Source citation: BLS QCEW Open Data, Alabama statewide, 2024 Q4 (https://data.bls.gov/cew/data/api/2024/4/area/01000.csv)
